post.title: Vans resold for 69% more. Vans got none of it
post.ig:
On StockX, Vans resold 69% above retail on average in the first half of 2026. Vans got none of that markup.

Brands get paid once, at the first sale. Nike sold $17.7B through its own stores and apps (NIKE Direct, incl. SNKRS) and $27.5B through retailers in fiscal 2026 (year ended May 31, 2026).
Hypothetical $200 shoe costing $90: full price keeps $110; 30% off ($140) keeps $50.
Nike's FY2025 10-K says higher discounts helped cut gross margin to 42.7%. FY2026: 42.9%, helped by an expected tariff refund.

Sources: NIKE, Inc. FY2025 and FY2026 Form 10-K; StockX Big Facts midyear report (Aug 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
